title: Aryan Simhadri doesn’t do anything by half measures | Percy Jackson and the Olympians
summary: Aryan Simhadri’s character Grover Underwood may be growing into his own in Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3, but Aryan himself is an entity of chaos. From revealing who’s most active in the Percy Jackson cast group chat to explaining why Walker Scobell is always dragging him on side quests, Aryan shares hilarious behind-the-scenes stories about his co-stars, why he’s the captain of the Luke Castellan defense squad, and the cast’s friendships on and off screen. Plus, he matches the Percy Jackson cast to Attack on Titan Titans, talks emotional scenes, and reveals his personal soundtrack for Season 3’s biggest moments.
